supports: Four Sui is a conditional squad-count threshold for static +12% ATK and separate periodic SP parameters; a nonempty API string does not provide that threshold condition.
Silverash S3 supplies damage_scale1.3 / displayed fragile30%; preexisting_fragile control is a declared full-period model condition, not proof of any first-hit application.
Original fields and public UI specify two-state checkbox choices; no public documentation found accepting arbitrary truthy strings as confirmation.
Qualification uses the same named selected talent that supplies the existing Four-Sui parameters; the gate does not use a guessed report/reference flag.
does_not_support: First periodic SP tick/reset/lockout handling or a new native schedule
Treating unknown / false / 0 text as a verified four-Sui squad or fragile condition
A new global API bool policy, conversion of numeric0/1/null, or rejection of inactive keys
Declaring older numeric0/1/null or container compatibility to be a new documented global API domain.
scope: Qualified Shu Four-Sui raw text input rejection only

changed_policy.talent_qualification: Existing selected_talents yields 天有四时 from the pinned PHASE_2 / level1 candidate.
changed_policy.unchanged_types: bool, numeric0/1/null and every other previous nonstr outcome
changed_policy.unchanged_inactive: Other owners, ineligible Shu E0/E1 and prior validation errors
changed_policy.exact_error_literal: four_sui 不接受文本条件；请使用布尔值。

external_draft_implemented_policy: Qualified Four-Sui raw str rejection only; no tracked integration
